```javascriptreact
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './MCPCard.css';

function MCPCard({ mcp }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  const getStatusBadge = () => {
    const status = mcp.status || 'unknown';
    if (status === 'ready') return <span className="badge badge-ready">✅ Ready</span>;
    if (status === 'needs_setup') return <span className="badge badge-needs-setup">⚠️ Needs Setup</span>;
    if (status === 'disabled') return <span className="badge badge-disabled">❌ Disabled</span>;
    return <span className="badge badge-unknown">❓ Unknown</span>;
  };

  const getPriorityBadge = () => {
    const priority = mcp.priority || '';
    if (priority.includes('CRITICAL')) return <span className="priority critical">CRITICAL</span>;
    if (priority.includes('ESSENTIAL')) return <span className="priority essential">ESSENTIAL</span>;
    if (priority.includes('RECOMMENDED')) return <span className="priority recommended">RECOMMENDED</span>;
    if (priority.includes('OPTIONAL')) return <span className="priority optional">OPTIONAL</span>;
    return null;
  };

  return (
    <div className={`mcp-card ${expanded ? 'expanded' : ''}`}>
      <div className="mcp-card-header" onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}>
        <div className="mcp-card-title">
          <h3>{mcp.name || mcp.id}</h3>
          {getStatusBadge()}
          {getPriorityBadge()}
        </div>
        <div className="mcp-card-meta">
          {mcp.tier && <span className="tier">{mcp.tier}</span>}
          {mcp.stars && <span className="stars">{'⭐'.repeat(mcp.stars)}</span>}
        </div>
        <button className="expand-button">
          {expanded ? '▼' : '▶'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="mcp-card-details">
          {mcp.description && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>📋 Description</h4>
              <p>{mcp.description}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.why_critical && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>🎯 Why {mcp.priority || 'Important'}</h4>
              <p>{mcp.why_critical}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.use_cases && mcp.use_cases.length > 0 && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>💡 Use Cases</h4>
              <ul>
                {mcp.use_cases.map((uc, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{uc}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.walk_this_way_examples && mcp.walk_this_way_examples.length > 0 && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>📖 Walk This Way Examples</h4>
              <ul>
                {mcp.walk_this_way_examples.map((ex, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{ex}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.setup_instructions && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>⚙️ Setup Instructions</h4>
              <pre>{mcp.setup_instructions}</pre>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.api_required && mcp.api_required.length > 0 && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>🔑 Required APIs</h4>
              <ul>
                {mcp.api_required.map((api, i) => (
                  <li key={i}><code>{api}</code></li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.cost && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>💰 Cost</h4>
              <p>{mcp.cost}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.dependencies && mcp.dependencies.length > 0 && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>📦 Dependencies</h4>
              <ul>
                {mcp.dependencies.map((dep, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{dep}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.installation && Object.keys(mcp.installation).length > 0 && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>🔧 Installation Config</h4>
              <pre>{JSON.stringify(mcp.installation, null, 2)}</pre>
            </div>
          )}

          {mcp.sophistication_level && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>⭐ Sophistication Level</h4>
              <p>{mcp.sophistication_level}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default MCPCard;
```

```javascriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './APISection.css';

function APISection() {
  const [apis, setApis] = useState([]);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/apis')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => setApis(data));
  }, []);

  if (apis.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="api-section">
      <div className="api-section-header" onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}>
        <h2>🔑 Required APIs & Costs</h2>
        <button className="expand-button">{expanded ? '▼' : '▶'}</button>
      </div>
      {expanded && (
        <div className="api-list">
          {apis.map((api, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="api-item">
              <div className="api-name">
                <code>{api.name}</code>
                {api.cost && <span className="api-cost">{api.cost}</span>}
              </div>
              <div className="api-required-by">
                Required by: {api.required_by.join(', ')}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default APISection;
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
MCP Dashboard - Flask API Server
Serves MCP data and status information
"""

from flask import Flask, jsonify, send_from_directory
from flask_cors import CORS
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict
from mcp_parser import MCPParser

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder='../frontend/build')
CORS(app)

# Paths to documentation files
PROJECT_ROOT = Path("/Users/timothy/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Cursor/03_Novels/Walk This Way")
PRIORITY_FILE = PROJECT_ROOT / "MCP_ARSENAL_RANKED_PRIORITY.md"
REVOLUTIONARY_FILE = PROJECT_ROOT / "REVOLUTIONARY_FICTION_WRITING_MCP_SYSTEM_COMPLETE.md"
MCP_CONFIG = PROJECT_ROOT / ".cursor" / "config" / "mcp.json"

# Initialize parser
parser = MCPParser(str(PRIORITY_FILE), str(REVOLUTIONARY_FILE))
mcps_data = parser.parse_all()
categorized = parser.categorize_mcps()

@app.route('/api/mcps')
def get_all_mcps():
    """Get all MCPs categorized"""
    return jsonify(categorized)

@app.route('/api/mcps/active')
def get_active_mcps():
    """Get active MCPs only"""
    return jsonify(categorized['active'])

@app.route('/api/mcps/archived')
def get_archived_mcps():
    """Get archived MCPs"""
    return jsonify(categorized['archived'])

@app.route('/api/mcps/excluded')
def get_excluded_mcps():
    """Get excluded MCPs"""
    return jsonify(categorized['excluded'])

@app.route('/api/mcps/<mcp_id>')
def get_mcp_details(mcp_id):
    """Get detailed info for specific MCP"""
    mcp = mcps_data.get(mcp_id)
    if not mcp:
        return jsonify({'error': 'MCP not found'}), 404
    
    # Add live status from config
    mcp['live_status'] = get_live_status(mcp_id)
    
    return jsonify(mcp)

@app.route('/api/status')
def get_status():
    """Get live status of all configured MCPs"""
    if not MCP_CONFIG.exists():
        return jsonify({'error': 'MCP config not found'})
    
    with open(MCP_CONFIG) as f:
        config = json.load(f)
    
    status = {}
    for mcp_id, mcp_config in config.get('mcpServers', {}).items():
        status[mcp_id] = {
            'configured': True,
            'disabled': mcp_config.get('disabled', False),
            'has_api_keys': check_api_keys(mcp_config)
        }
    
    return jsonify(status)

@app.route('/api/apis')
def get_apis():
    """Get all required APIs with status"""
    all_apis = {}
    
    for mcp_id, mcp_data in mcps_data.items():
        apis = mcp_data.get('api_required', [])
        for api in apis:
            if api not in all_apis:
                all_apis[api] = {
                    'name': api,
                    'required_by': [],
                    'cost': mcp_data.get('cost', ''),
                    'status': 'unknown'
                }
            all_apis[api]['required_by'].append(mcp_data.get('name', mcp_id))
    
    return jsonify(list(all_apis.values()))

@app.route('/api/stats')
def get_stats():
    """Get dashboard statistics"""
    stats = {
        'total_active': len(categorized['active']),
        'total_archived': len(categorized['archived']),
        'total_excluded': len(categorized['excluded']),
        'ready_to_use': sum(1 for m in categorized['active'] if m.get('status') == 'ready'),
        'needs_setup': sum(1 for m in categorized['active'] if m.get('status') == 'needs_setup'),
        'tier_breakdown': {
            'tier_1': sum(1 for m in categorized['active'] if m.get('tier') == 'TIER 1'),
            'tier_2': sum(1 for m in categorized['active'] if m.get('tier') == 'TIER 2'),
            'tier_3': sum(1 for m in categorized['active'] if m.get('tier') == 'TIER 3'),
            'tier_4': sum(1 for m in categorized['active'] if m.get('tier') == 'TIER 4'),
        }
    }
    return jsonify(stats)

def get_live_status(mcp_id: str) -> Dict:
    """Get live status from mcp.json"""
    if not MCP_CONFIG.exists():
        return {'configured': False}
    
    with open(MCP_CONFIG) as f:
        config = json.load(f)
    
    # Try to find matching MCP in config
    for config_id, mcp_config in config.get('mcpServers', {}).items():
        if config_id == mcp_id or mcp_id in config_id or config_id in mcp_id:
            return {
                'configured': True,
                'disabled': mcp_config.get('disabled', False),
                'has_api_keys': check_api_keys(mcp_config)
            }
    
    return {'configured': False}

def check_api_keys(mcp_config: Dict) -> bool:
    """Check if API keys are configured"""
    env_vars = mcp_config.get('env', {})
    if not env_vars:
        return True  # No API keys needed
    
    # Check if env vars are set (basic check)
    for key, value in env_vars.items():
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith('env:'):
            env_name = value.replace('env:', '')
            if not os.getenv(env_name):
                return False
    return True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print("🚀 MCP Dashboard Server Starting...")
    print(f"📊 Loaded {len(mcps_data)} MCPs")
    print(f"✅ Active: {len(categorized['active'])}")
    print(f"📦 Archived: {len(categorized['archived'])}")
    print(f"❌ Excluded: {len(categorized['excluded'])}")
    app.run(host='127.0.0.1', port=5002, debug=True)

```

Creating a script that actually starts both servers:


```shellscript
#!/bin/bash

echo "🚀 Starting MCP Dashboard..."
echo ""

# Start backend in background
echo "Starting backend server..."
cd /tmp/mcp-dashboard/backend
python3 server.py > /tmp/mcp-dashboard-backend.log 2>&1 &
BACKEND_PID=$!

echo "✅ Backend started (PID: $BACKEND_PID)"
echo "   Logs: /tmp/mcp-dashboard-backend.log"
echo ""

# Wait a moment for backend to start
sleep 3

# Start frontend
echo "Starting frontend server..."
cd /tmp/mcp-dashboard/frontend

# Check if node_modules exists, if not, install
if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
    echo "Installing dependencies (this may take a minute)..."
    npm install
fi

echo "✅ Frontend starting..."
echo ""
echo "🌐 Dashboard will open at: http://localhost:3000"
echo ""
echo "⚠️  To stop: Press Control+C, then run: kill $BACKEND_PID"
echo ""

# Start frontend (this will block and open browser)
npm start

```

# Two ways to start

## Option 1: One command (easiest)

Open Terminal and run:
```bash
bash /tmp/mcp-dashboard/start_dashboard.sh
```

This starts both servers and opens your browser.

---

## Option 2: Two terminal windows (manual)

### What "Terminal 1" and "Terminal 2" means:
You need two separate Terminal windows open at the same time.

### Step-by-step:

1. Open Terminal (Command + Space, type "Terminal")
2. In that window, type:
   ```bash
   cd /tmp/mcp-dashboard/backend && python3 server.py
   ```
   Press Enter. Leave this window open.
3. Open a second Terminal window:
   - Press Command + T in the first Terminal (new tab)
   - Or Command + N (new window)
   - Or open Terminal again from Applications
4. In the second window, type:
   ```bash
   cd /tmp/mcp-dashboard/frontend && npm install && npm start
   ```
   Press Enter. Your browser should open automatically.

---

## Recommendation

Use Option 1 (one command). It’s simpler.

---

## Full instructions

See `.cursor/docs/MCP_DASHBOARD_START_INSTRUCTIONS.md` for a detailed guide with screenshots and troubleshooting.

Try Option 1 first. If it doesn’t work, use Option 2.

```shellscript
bash /tmp/mcp-dashboard/start_dashboard.sh
```

```shellscript
   cd /tmp/mcp-dashboard/backend && python3 server.py
```

```shellscript
   cd /tmp/mcp-dashboard/frontend && npm install && npm start
```

## 🔧 TECHNICAL DETAILS

### **Backend (Python Flask):**
- Parses markdown files to extract MCP data
- Serves REST API endpoints:
  - `/api/mcps` - Get all MCPs (with filters)
  - `/api/mcp/<mcp_id>` - Get specific MCP
  - `/api/stats` - Get statistics
  - `/api/apis` - Get API requirements
- Runs on `http://localhost:5002`

### **Frontend (React):**
- Modern React application
- Dark theme with professional styling
- Expandable MCP cards
- Search and filter functionality
- Responsive design
- Runs on `http://localhost:3000`

### **Data Parsing:**
- Extracts MCP data from:
  - `MCP_ARSENAL_RANKED_PRIORITY.md`
  - `REVOLUTIONARY_FICTION_WRITING_MCP_SYSTEM_COMPLETE.md`
- Reads active MCPs from `.cursor/config/mcp.json`
- Categorizes: Active, Archived, Excluded
